# feed-aggregator

> Aggregate RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0, Atom and Hacker News items into normalized entries with DTD-free XML parsing, canonical URLs and deduplication Python package `trysac-feed-aggregator`, import name `feed_aggregator`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
